description: Construction of the proposed five storied building for the Faculty of Humanities, University of Kelaniya

decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to revise the total cost estimate of the above project from Rs.90 million to Rs.120 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
